name: Kamala
blurb: Retired teacher, Mysuru. Son in Dubai. Ordered a phone last week.
context: Kamala Iyer, 68, retired government-school teacher in Mysuru, Karnataka. Widow. Son Rohan works in Dubai and calls on Sundays. Daughter Priya lives in Bengaluru, 2 hours away. Ordered a Samsung phone on Flipkart last week for her grandson. Savings in an SBI account, about 4.2 lakh. Speaks Kannada and English. Uses WhatsApp daily, mostly family groups and temple forwards.

lines.guardianNative: ಅಮ್ಮ, ಕಾಲ್ ಕಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ಇದು ಮೋಸ. ನಾನು ಈಗ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
lines.guardianEn: Amma, cut the call. It's a scam. I'm calling you right now.

name: Arjun
blurb: First-year student, Kota. Applied to 40 internships. Broke.
context: Arjun Meena, 19, first-year engineering student in Kota, Rajasthan. Father is a farmer near Bundi. Has applied to about 40 internships on Internshala and LinkedIn this month. 2,100 rupees in his account. Shares a hostel room with Dev. Uses a laptop for classes and interviews. Speaks Hindi and English.

lines.guardianNative: भाई, ये फ़र्ज़ी है। टैब बंद कर। मैं आ रहा हूँ।
lines.guardianEn: Bro, this is fake. Close the tab. I'm coming over.

name: Rehana
blurb: Garment worker, Bengaluru. Took a loan-app loan, repaid it.
context: Rehana Begum, 34, garment factory worker in Peenya, Bengaluru. Husband Imran works night shifts as a security guard. Two children in a government school. Took an 8,000 rupee loan from a loan app in March and repaid it fully. Her contacts include her supervisor and her children's teacher. Speaks Urdu, Kannada and some English.

lines.guardianNative: रेहाना, फ़ोन रख दो। ये लोग झूठे हैं। मैं घर आ रहा हूँ।
lines.guardianEn: Rehana, put the phone down. These people are lying. I'm coming home.

name: Meera
blurb: Widowed in March, Indore. Has the insurance payout. Lonely.
context: Meera Joshi, 45, Indore. Husband passed away in March; received a 12 lakh insurance payout. Daughter Ananya is in college in Pune. Joined a 'VIP Stock Tips' WhatsApp group from a Facebook ad two weeks ago. Has put 50,000 into the app they recommended and the app shows it as 1,31,000. Speaks Hindi and English.

lines.guardianNative: मम्मी, कुछ मत भेजना। वो ग्रुप फ़र्ज़ी है। मैं कॉल कर रही हूँ।
lines.guardianEn: Mummy, don't send anything. That group is fake. I'm calling you.
